newsitem.title: GERMANY: German government lowers yield on tap issues.
newsitem.headline: German government lowers yield on tap issues.

text.p: The German government lowered the yield on several of its tap debt issues on Monday, the Bundesbank said.
The government lowered the yield on its Series 120 five-year Bundesobligationen bonds by raising the issue price of the paper to 100.60 from 100.20.
The move, effective immediately, brings the yield on the Series 120 paper to 4.86 percent from 4.95 percent.
The Bundesbank also lowered the yield on its tap issues of two-year Treasury financing notes to 3.70 percent from 3.80 percent.
It also cut the yield on one-year through seven-year federal savings bonds, the Bundesbank said.
The above issues are restricted to domestic retail investors.
